model: CFB current-season resume rating: opponent-adjusted W/L (75%) + scoring/yardage composite (25%), head-to-head near-tie rule
method: Resume-first ranking over every 2026 FBS final through 2026-11-01 (622 games). 75% opponent-adjusted win-loss rating (Colley: quality wins count more, bad losses cost more, strength of schedule is an output of results); 25% opponent-adjusted scoring/yardage performance composite, so stats support results rather than drive the ranking. Head-to-head: inside a 1.5-rating-point near-tie, this season's head-to-head winner ranks ahead, applied transitively; circular cases fall back to the full-season resume. Current-season performance only: no preseason talent, returning-production, portal, draft or AP-poll inputs, and no prior-season results. Values are an unvalidated rating scale, not a calibrated expected margin. The AP-fit column is a separately trained research variant that failed its Week 7 gate; the fixed-reference column is the sealed Oct 11 forecast specification (which does use preseason inputs) shown for audit only. Neither is a validated betting edge.
